verdict.rationale: Kong's plugin architecture explicitly includes logging and monitoring plugins (kong-gh-3) and an AI observability feature set (kong-gh-9, kong-gh-19), supporting metrics/log integrations for API traffic. However, there's no explicit documentation of tracing integrations (e.g., OpenTelemetry/Zipkin) or named metrics backends (Prometheus/Datadog), and a community report shows a real-world case where Kong's logging failed to surface an underlying issue (kong-comm-1, kong-comm-2), indicating some practical gaps in observability. missing for 10: explicit tracing integration docs (OpenTelemetry/Zipkin), named metrics exporters (Prometheus/Datadog), and resolution to the logged 404/cache-rebuild gap.
